title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Radar Scope Deck. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Radar Scope Deck
options.thesis: Night-ops console: specialty glows on the scope; skills sit as a labeled legend strip under the CRT.
options.viewport: Dark console: name + specialty over the scope face; skills as scannable text labels in a legend strip directly under the hero; contact on the bezel.
options.risk: Reads military cosplay if phosphor outranks project proof and plain skill words.

raised.raise: Lead project owns one highlighted active lane — a single focus ring on the scope, never a full syntax stage.
Contact stays edge-ranked caps on the bezel — Email, LinkedIn, GitHub always visible.
Skills read as sequential labeled rows under the motif — fixed legend order, not freeform glow.
Brightest white reserved for the skills legend under the hero — dimmer phosphor for atmosphere only.

options.label: Obsidian Spec Sheet
options.lineage: industrial product datasheet on charcoal stock
options.thesis: Dark industrial datasheet: specialty is the nameplate; skills are a labeled SPEC row under the hero plate.
options.viewport: Full-bleed dark sheet: nameplate + one project plate as hero; SPEC skills row with plain labels under it; contact in the footer rule.
options.risk: Also the direction most specialty portfolios land on — familiar, effective.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.thesis: Skills and proof as labeled tube banks on blackened steel; specialty engraved on the chassis cap.
options.viewport: Steel panel hero with specialty cap; skills as labeled tube banks under the chassis title — readable words, not digits alone.
options.case: Holds product clarity via fixed labeled banks; loses hiring-manager identification to ops-console evaluation.
options.risk: Novelty gadget if orange glow outranks plain skill names.

options.label: Plate Section
options.thesis: Continuous sheet with registration marks; sticky mono skill tokens under the lead plate.
options.viewport: Lead project plate as hero; sticky mono skill tokens as a labeled bar under the plate; contact as filled mono rect.
options.case: Holds clarity with sticky labeled skills; light stock fights the dark preference and slows night-ops identification.
options.risk: Reads print-portfolio default when the sheet stays near-white.

options.label: Algorave Floor
options.case: Hiring managers do not identify with rave-floor code; specialty and skills drown in syntax theater.
options.kept: Single highlighted active lane — donated as one focus ring for the lead project.

options.label: Matchbook Drawer
options.case: Club ephemera identification misses hiring seriousness; skills do not fit pocket covers as scannable labels.
options.kept: Edge-ranked contact caps — donated as always-visible bezel links.

options.label: Jacquard Brocade
options.case: Fashion-loom culture fails hiring identification; binary motif buries plain skill words.
options.kept: Sequential labeled rows under the motif — donated as ordered skills legend.

options.label: Alien Understory
options.case: Surreal botany fails hiring identification; proximity glow hides scannable skill labels.
options.kept: Brightest white for focus — donated as high-contrast skills legend under hero.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark hero, role headline, skills strip under hero, project proof — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Dark hero with name and specialty; skills as scannable text labels in a strip under the hero; Get in touch CTA.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from competing engineer portfolios by design.
